summary: Dan adopted the FieldMouth domain split as ecosystem Approved Canon, effective July 10, 2026, while preserving the June 29 builder-registry framing within the standard and registry role.
decisions: FieldMouth.com is the home of the standard: the Transformation Contract specification, invariant definitions, Evidence Interface, public transformation-contract registry, PROV-compatibility statement, and supporting developer-facing builder, registry, and versioning interfaces.
FieldMouthAI.com is the home of the product: the governed runtime, tool catalog, pricing, and reference implementation, with its authority and claims pointing back to the standard at FieldMouth.com.

The June 29 FieldMouth.com builder-registry framing is preserved within this structure. It describes interfaces serving the standard and registry; it does not convert FieldMouth.com into the commercial runtime product.
completed_work: Dan explicitly adopted the complete domain-split ruling in writing as his human-authored Approved Canon record.
The earlier builder-registry framing was reconciled as a supporting interface of the FieldMouth.com standard and registry rather than silently abandoned or superseded.
open_items: Audit FieldMouth.com and FieldMouthAI.com documentation and site content for conflicts with the approved domain split.
Attach the June 29 builder-registry source artifact and exact spans when available.

The June 29 builder-registry framing remains valid inside FieldMouth.com's standard-and-registry role.
